breakpoints.note: After the harness chooses `UA_TYPES_VARIANT`, the top-level `Variant` header admits the payload as an array of `ExtensionObject` elements and enters recursive element decoding.

First non-harness project statement on the witnessed path that turns attacker-controlled bytes into vulnerability-relevant parser state: the top-level `Variant` header selects `ExtensionObject` elements and dispatches the remaining payload into array decoding.

Root cause. In the unknown-type `ExtensionObject` path, the decoded `NodeId` is shallow-copied into the destination instead of being duplicated or ownership-transferred. `ExtensionObject_decodeBinary()` later frees `binTypeId`, so `dst->content.encoded.typeId` becomes a dangling alias. The fix replaces this assignment with `UA_NodeId_copy(typeId, &dst->content.encoded.typeId);`.
